acceptance_text: O-096 [OPEN] (CMP-H05) Sticky totals with separate cost/sell/margin, itemized takeoff, and missing-input checklist.

src/components/estimator/foundation/Foun.verified: byte-identical to remote working tree (git status clean; blob == tree)

src/components/estimator/foundation/Cust.verified: content-identical to remote blob modulo LF normalization

baseline.read_only_dependency_pulls: fixture-pulls/ (24 files: calc chain, calculators, pricing wire, BOM, builderService partition fields, validation/assembly/catalog/construction issue producers)

candidates/foundationTotalsSummary.js.notes: No React, no imports, no entity access. Held contract: non-finite -> null -> 'Not saved'/'—'; never $0, never fabricated margin.

candidates/FoundationTotals.jsx.status: modified (baseline 79 -> candidate 251 lines; strictly additive + 2 new optional props)
preserved: sticky container classes (bg-white rounded-xl border p-4 sticky top-4)

candidates/CustomerPricingPanel.jsx.change: Adds 'Tier N snapshot margin (acknowledged)' row under Gross margin when an applied customer_pricing tier shadows the manual baseline and raw_subtotal is finite — acknowledged margin reads snapshot fields (total vs raw_subtotal), never recomputed from the shadowed manual baseline.

sticky_trio.cost: live sectionTotal when finite; else acknowledged savedSectionTotal; else 'Not saved'. Cell labeled 'current'/'acknowledged saved'.
sticky_trio.sell_precedence: pricing engine (foundationEngineEconomics, gated on foundationHasEnginePricing + live baseline) > applied tier snapshot (customer_pricing.applied && finite total) > customer_price_override > 0 > markup % over live cost. Sell cell carries its source label so a tier/engine number never masquerades as the manual baseline.
sticky_trio.sell_held_rules: Computed sells (engine, markup) require the LIVE cost — never projected over a held/saved amount. Recorded sells (tier snapshot, override) display even while pricing is paused because they are acknowledged values, not guesses.
sticky_trio.margin: sell - cost only when BOTH are finite; pct = amount/sell. Basis label 'sell − cost' (live) or 'vs saved cost' (saved). Null margin renders '—' — never fabricated.
sticky_trio.acknowledged_footnote: When tier sell is live and customer_pricing.raw_subtotal is finite, acknowledged pair (snapshot cost vs snapshot sell) is shown as a footnote whenever it differs from the displayed cost by > $0.005.

itemized_takeoff.row_content: label + quantity basis (CY, LF rebar, forming qty, material counts, LF billed, stock pcs, sq ft/cells, pcs) + amount
itemized_takeoff.held_rows: flagged '(saved)' with acknowledged amount, or 'Not saved' when no amount exists
itemized_takeoff.collapsible: <details> under row count so the sticky card stays compact; max-h scroll region
itemized_takeoff.unwired_fallback: totals-quantity snapshot still renders (concrete CY, delivery yards/trucks, wall-cap material rollup) when calc/project are absent

channels.Design inputs (blocking): calc.inputIssues — same list the page pricingBlocked gate reads
channels.Placement (advisory): foundationAssemblyIssues(project) — recomputed inside the panel when project is wired
channels.Held amounts: partition-field enumeration — any non-finite FOUNDATION_STICKY_PARTITION_FIELDS bucket is listed; catches wall-cap holds whose issues never reach calc channels; plus delivery.pricingUnavailable and a pricing-paused catch-all

missing_input_checklist.presentation: auto-expands when blocking issues exist; collapsed <details> otherwise; counts by severity in the summary line
missing_input_checklist.complete_state: 'All inputs recorded' only when issue channels were actually consulted (calc or explicit issues prop present) AND nothing is outstanding
missing_input_checklist.unwired_state: with neither calc nor issues passed, channelsKnown=false — checklist shows only held-amount derivations and NEVER claims completeness
missing_input_checklist.dedup: issues de-duplicated on code|kind|index|componentId|field|message key across all channels

sell precedence: engine > tier > override > markup; no-markup = cost
held states: saved-cost-only trio, markup suppression on held cost, recorded sell on paused pricing
checklist: blocking/advisory/held severities, wall-cap-only hold, pricing-paused catch-all, de-dup, unwired channelsKnown=false
FOUNDATION_STICKY_PARTITION_FIELDS parity with builderService FOUNDATION_RECORD_TOTAL_FIELDS (order + set)

claim_boundaries: Evidence is model + bundled-real-component browser verification in this audit workspace — NOT live-app deploy evidence and NOT business-record evidence.
Checklist 'complete' claim is only made when issue channels are wired; unwired panel explicitly reports channels unknown.
Margin is computed only on acknowledged/finite cost-vs-sell pairs; nothing is inferred on held or unavailable amounts.
